page_title: STU 1-2 WOL | Stuttgart v Wolfsburg 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tobias Welz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' We are about to witness a substitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is replacing Mohamed Amoura.
90+3' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) was probably a bit loose with his words to Tobias Welz, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+3' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Tobias Welz's book.
90+1' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Tiago Tomas is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
90+1' A pass by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. Josha Vagnoman is given a rest as he is replaced by Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart).
88' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Atakan Karazor and he is replaced by Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart).
87' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alexander Nubel no chance!
87' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is going to take the penalty!
87' The Wolfsburg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
86' There's a break in play and referee Tobias Welz must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Wolfsburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
86' Surely that's handball by one of the Stuttgart players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
84' The referee blows his whistle, Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
84' A substitution has been made. Chris Fuhrich is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
79' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Amoura provides Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 1:1.
76' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Welz ignores the protests.

72' 1 - 0 Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Marius Muller is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
72' The attendance for today's match is 59000.
71' Substitution. Jonas Wind is replaced by Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg).
70' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Deniz Undav will be replaced by Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart).
70' A substitution has been made. Jamie Leweling goes off and Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
70' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) heads on.
69' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
62' Total attempts – 8:2.
60' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
60' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
58' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
55' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
54' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
53' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Marius Muller has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
52' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
49' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a half-time substitution. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Kilian Fischer.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Tobias Welz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) gets a yellow card. The referee Tobias Welz made the right call.
45+4' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Welz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45+4' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+1' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) for his blatant foul.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
42' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
41' The current number of corner kicks is 3:3.
39' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

34' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Marius Muller, who pulls off a comfortable save!
32' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
30' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.
29' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
29' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
26' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Wolfsburg for a penalty. Play continues.
25' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
24' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
20' 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
18' Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) hacks down one of his opponents.
16' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
15' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
13' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
13' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
10' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
9' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
8' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
8' A yellow card for a tackle by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg). Tobias Welz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
5' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
4' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' The free kick into the penalty area from Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Stuttgart will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
